package headercollection_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"reflect"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	svc "example.com/headercollection/gen/headers"
	client "example.com/headercollection/gen/http/headers/client"
	server "example.com/headercollection/gen/http/headers/server"
	loomhttp "github.com/CaliLuke/loom/http"
)

func TestCollectionRequestWire(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name        string
		tags        []string
		numbers     []string
		wantTags    []string
		wantNumbers []int
	}{
		{"repeated-strings", []string{"a", "b"}, nil, []string{"a", "b"}, nil},
		{"combined-strings", []string{"a, b"}, nil, []string{"a", "b"}, nil},
		{"empty-members", []string{"a,,b,"}, nil, []string{"a", "b"}, nil},
		{"present-empty", []string{""}, nil, []string{}, nil},
		{"mixed-strings", []string{"a", "b, c"}, nil, []string{"a", "b", "c"}, nil},
		{"repeated-numbers", nil, []string{"1", "2"}, nil, []int{1, 2}},
		{"combined-numbers", nil, []string{"1, 2"}, nil, []int{1, 2}},
		{"single-controls", []string{"a"}, []string{"1"}, []string{"a"}, []int{1}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			seen := make(chan *svc.Values, 1)
			host := collectionServer(t, seen)
			req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, host.URL+"/echo", nil)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			for _, v := range tc.tags {
				req.Header.Add("X-Tags", v)
			}
			for _, v := range tc.numbers {
				req.Header.Add("X-Numbers", v)
			}
			req.Header.Set("X-Label", "scalar, unchanged")
			res, err := host.Client().Do(req)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.NoError(t, res.Body.Close())
			require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, res.StatusCode)
			select {
			case got := <-seen:
				require.Equal(t, tc.wantTags, got.Tags)
				require.Equal(t, tc.wantNumbers, got.Numbers)
				require.NotNil(t, got.Label)
				require.Equal(t, "scalar, unchanged", *got.Label)
			default:
				t.Error("service did not receive the decoded payload")
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCollectionResponseWire(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name        string
		tags        []string
		numbers     []string
		wantTags    []string
		wantNumbers []int
	}{
		{"repeated-strings", []string{"a", "b"}, nil, []string{"a", "b"}, nil},
		{"combined-strings", []string{"a, b"}, nil, []string{"a", "b"}, nil},
		{"empty-members", []string{"a,,b,"}, nil, []string{"a", "b"}, nil},
		{"present-empty", []string{""}, nil, []string{}, nil},
		{"mixed-numbers", nil, []string{"1", "2, 3"}, nil, []int{1, 2, 3}},
		{"repeated-numbers", nil, []string{"1", "2"}, nil, []int{1, 2}},
		{"single-controls", []string{"a"}, []string{"1"}, []string{"a"}, []int{1}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			host := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
				for _, v := range tc.tags {
					w.Header().Add("X-Tags", v)
				}
				for _, v := range tc.numbers {
					w.Header().Add("X-Numbers", v)
				}
				w.Header().Set("X-Label", "scalar, unchanged")
				w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
			}))
			t.Cleanup(host.Close)
			res, err := collectionClient(t, host).Echo()(context.Background(), &svc.Values{})
			require.NoError(t, err)
			got := res.(*svc.Values)
			require.Equal(t, tc.wantTags, got.Tags)
			require.Equal(t, tc.wantNumbers, got.Numbers)
			require.NotNil(t, got.Label)
			require.Equal(t, "scalar, unchanged", *got.Label)
		})
	}
}

func TestCollectionGeneratedRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name  string
		value *svc.Values
	}{
		{"strings", &svc.Values{Tags: []string{"a", "b", "c"}}},
		{"numbers", &svc.Values{Numbers: []int{1, 2, 3}}},
		{"single-controls", &svc.Values{Tags: []string{"a"}, Numbers: []int{1}}},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			host := collectionServer(t, nil)
			res, err := collectionClient(t, host).Echo()(context.Background(), tc.value)
			require.NoError(t, err)
			require.Equal(t, tc.value, res)
		})
	}
}

func TestCollectionPresence(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name   string
		values []string
		want   []string
	}{
		{"absent", nil, nil},
		{"present-empty", []string{}, []string{""}},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/echo", nil)
			require.NoError(t, client.EncodeEchoRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder)(req, &svc.Values{Tags: tc.values}))
			if got := req.Header.Values("X-Tags"); !reflect.DeepEqual(tc.want, got) {
				t.Errorf("request lines=%#v, want %#v", got, tc.want)
			}
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			require.NoError(t, server.EncodeEchoResponse(loomhttp.ResponseEncoder)(context.Background(), response, &svc.Values{Tags: tc.values}))
			require.Equal(t, tc.want, response.Header().Values("X-Tags"))
		})
	}
}

func TestCollectionOutboundAdmission(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name    string
		values  []string
		invalid bool
	}{
		{"ordinary", []string{"a", "b"}, false},
		{"embedded-space", []string{"a b"}, false},
		{"comma", []string{"a,b"}, true},
		{"empty-item", []string{""}, true},
		{"leading-space", []string{" a"}, true},
		{"trailing-tab", []string{"a\t"}, true},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/echo", nil)
			requestErr := client.EncodeEchoRequest(loomhttp.RequestEncoder)(req, &svc.Values{Tags: tc.values})
			response := httptest.NewRecorder()
			responseErr := server.EncodeEchoResponse(loomhttp.ResponseEncoder)(context.Background(), response, &svc.Values{Tags: tc.values})
			for side, err := range map[string]error{"request": requestErr, "response": responseErr} {
				if (err != nil) != tc.invalid {
					t.Errorf("%s error=%v, want rejected=%t", side, err, tc.invalid)
				}
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestCollectionInvalidDoesNotInvokeService(t *testing.T) {
	seen := make(chan *svc.Values, 1)
	host := collectionServer(t, seen)
	_, err := collectionClient(t, host).Echo()(context.Background(), &svc.Values{Tags: []string{"private,comma"}})
	require.Error(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, err.Error(), "private")
	select {
	case <-seen:
		t.Error("service invoked after rejected outgoing header")
	default:
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, host.URL+"/echo", nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	req.Header.Set("X-Numbers", "not-an-integer")
	res, err := host.Client().Do(req)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, res.Body.Close())
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusBadRequest, res.StatusCode)
	select {
	case <-seen:
		t.Error("service invoked after rejected incoming header")
	default:
	}
}

func collectionServer(t *testing.T, seen chan<- *svc.Values) *httptest.Server {
	t.Helper()
	endpoints := &svc.Endpoints{Echo: func(ctx context.Context, v any) (any, error) {
		p := v.(*svc.Values)
		if seen != nil {
			seen <- p
		}
		return p, nil
	}}
	mux := loomhttp.NewMuxer()
	server.Mount(mux, server.New(endpoints, mux, loomhttp.RequestDecoder, loomhttp.ResponseEncoder, nil, nil))
	host := httptest.NewServer(mux)
	t.Cleanup(host.Close)
	return host
}

func collectionClient(t *testing.T, host *httptest.Server) *client.Client {
	t.Helper()
	u, err := url.Parse(host.URL)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	return client.NewClient(u.Scheme, u.Host, host.Client(), loomhttp.RequestEncoder, loomhttp.ResponseDecoder, false)
}
